scenes.say: My AI coach says my Zone 2 rides turn into tempo. Is it me, or the mountain?
Before a ride, I give it a route and a start time. It answers in two lines.
On this loop, Zone 2 is possible on 89 percent of the kilometres, but only 70 percent of the time.
On this climb, even in my easiest gear, at the slowest cadence I can hold, the slope asks for 1.7 times my Zone 2 ceiling.
After the ride, I give it the FIT file from my bike computer.
119 minutes above Zone 2. 45 imposed by the road, 5 by the heat, 70 mine.
Physics for the slope. TabPFN, running locally, for the time. A straight line beat it on heart rate, so the tool keeps the line there.
Over ten rides, the road made 98 minutes. I made 522. My coach was right.
Open source, open weights, on your own machine.
